lines: RHAPSODY OF REALITIES DEVOTIONAL FOR TODAY SUNDAY 5TH JANUARY 2026.

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: As discussed in our previous study, when you received the Holy Spirit, you didn’t get a portion of Him; you received the fullness of the Spirit. God doesn’t give the Holy Spirit by measure in the New Testament.

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: You’ve received the same Spirit that raised the Lord Jesus from the dead and empowered Him to work miracles, heal the sick, cast out devils, and raise the dead.

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: Now that you’re born again, don’t wait for another outpouring or a higher dimension of the Spirit; you already have all of Him living in you. What you need is the bold expression of His person and presence within you.

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: The more conscious you are of the Spirit’s indwelling, the more He manifests Himself to you and through you. The Holy Spirit isn’t a feeling, a wind, or a power; He’s the Father that dwells in you, just as the Lord Jesus said in John 14:10, “…the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.”

slides.label: Verse 12
lines: When He said this, He was referring to the Holy Spirit. Therefore, refuse to think you’re limited, disadvantaged or hamstrung. You’re full of divine energy, wisdom and ability. You’re more than a conqueror.

slides.label: Verse 13
lines: You can do all things. You’ve overcome Satan, the world, every adversary and adversity, because the greater One lives in you: “Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world” (1 John 4:4).

slides.label: Verse 14
lines: When you speak, it’s God speaking through you. When you lay hands on the sick, it’s the Holy Spirit ministering through you. You’re His living temple, His tabernacle of witness, the ark of His presence. You carry His glory, righteousness, grace and love everywhere you go.

slides.label: Verse 15
lines: PRAYER

slides.label: Verse 16
lines: Thank you, blessed Father, for granting me the fullness of the Spirit; His presence and power are active in me, producing excellence, victory and success in every area of my life. I’m full of divine wisdom and power, and I manifest the glory and dominion of Christ today, in Jesus’ Name. Amen.
